description: Entry point the host invokes when the user opens an audio or video file with this plugin: opens the uploader view and starts speech-to-text. You do not call this directly; for a file attached to the conversation use transcriptlab_transcribe_file.

diarize.description: Label speakers; defaults to false. Implies tier=premium and 10 credits per audio minute.

file.description: Host-provided handle for the opened file.

name: transcriptlab_open_audio
title: Transcribe an audio file
